1.consolidated_definition: Variedad de chopa, de agua dulce, caracterizada por el color rojo del área ventral y abdominal y por tener la punta del opérculo alargada y negra. (Centrarchidae, Lepomis auritus).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Variety of chopa, a freshwater fish, characterized by the red coloration on the ventral and abdominal areas and by having an elongated and black tip to the operculum (Centrarchidae, Lepomis auritus).
